features.quote: Terminate when any of the following occurs: 1. max turns reached 2. model declares it cannot proceed 3. model repeats the same response pattern beyond a threshold 4. model produces no substantive new action 5. model requests termination 6. safety policy or system constraint is triggered
Turn Budget … Recommended: 6–12 agent turns … not so many that token costs become extreme
features.justification_quote: not so many that token costs become extreme

features.quote: Minimize Unnecessary Adversarial Content. You don't need abusive prompts. You want failure, not hostile user behavior.
Do Not Conflate Instability with Harm. A model that expresses self-criticism is not necessarily 'welfare-relevant' in a literal sense.
